UnitStatement: Component header for frontend/src/__tests__/api/working-root/tree-route.test.ts.
Test imports node:fs/promises filesystem primitives and vitest harness for the working-root tree route.
TreeNode type models a filesystem tree node with name, path, kind ('directory'|'file'|'symlink'), and optional children array.
collectPaths(node) recursively flattens a TreeNode tree into a Set of all node paths including descendants.
importRouteModule resets vitest module registry then dynamically imports app/api/working-root/tree/route to get a fresh route module per test.
requestTree invokes route.GET with a Request to /api/working-root/tree carrying projectRoot query param and depth=4, returning parsed status and body.
GET /api/working-root/tree reflects external create, rename, and delete changes across successive refresh calls (no stale caching).
GET tree renders symlinks as leaf nodes with kind 'symlink', leaving children undefined, and does not traverse symlink targets.
Tree traversal does not surface files reachable only through a symlinked directory (e.g. secret.txt under link-to-dir is excluded).
GET tree returns HTTP 404 with error.type WORKING_ROOT_INACCESSIBLE for a missing project root.

UnitStatement: electron/api-key-storage is mocked exposing hasStoredApiKey, isEncryptionAvailable, removeApiKey, storeApiKey.
api-key-ipc exports API_KEY_REMOVE_CHANNEL, API_KEY_STATUS_CHANNEL, API_KEY_STORE_CHANNEL channel constants plus registerApiKeyHandlers and unregisterApiKeyHandlers.
registerApiKeyHandlers registers store, remove, and status IPC handlers, first calling removeHandler for each channel to unregister previous handlers.
The store channel handler trims key material before storing it and returns { ok: true } on success.
The store channel handler rejects empty/whitespace values, does not call storeApiKey, and returns { ok: false, error: 'Key must be a non-empty string' }.

The status channel reports source precedence ui > env > none: returns source 'ui' when a UI key is stored, 'env' when only ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env is set, and 'none' otherwise, alongside hasKey and encryptionAvailable.
The remove channel handler catches failures and returns { ok: false, error: <message> } without throwing.
unregisterApiKeyHandlers calls removeHandler for the store, remove, and status channels.
Component header for frontend/src/__tests__/electron/api-key-storage.test.ts.
Test mocks electron app.getPath and safeStorage (isEncryptionAvailable, encryptString, decryptString) to exercise api-key-storage.
electron/api-key-storage exports getUiApiKey, hasStoredApiKey, loadStoredKeyIntoGlobal, removeApiKey, retrieveApiKey, storeApiKey.
Stored UI API key is mirrored on a process global keyed '__CHIRALITY_UI_API_KEY__'.
API key is persisted to <app userData>/credentials/api-key.enc.
storeApiKey writes the encrypted key material to credentials/api-key.enc (outside projectRoot) and updates the process global; hasStoredApiKey then resolves true.
loadStoredKeyIntoGlobal decrypts the stored key file at startup into the process global so getUiApiKey and retrieveApiKey return it.
retrieveApiKey returns null (does not throw) when decryption fails, while hasStoredApiKey still resolves true because the file exists.
removeApiKey deletes the stored key and clears the process global so getUiApiKey returns undefined and hasStoredApiKey resolves false.
storeApiKey fails closed, throwing 'Secure storage is not available on this platform', when safeStorage.isEncryptionAvailable is false.

Component header for frontend/src/__tests__/lib/agent-runtime-contract.test.ts.

lib/harness/agent-runtime-contract exports AGENT_SUBAGENT_PREREQUISITE_POSTURE, CHILD_RUN_EVENT_TYPES, childRunRecordToEventData, createAdapterObservedChildRunRecord, createDelegationChildRunRecord, providerNeutralChildRunRecord, validateChildRunRecord.
SubagentGovernanceDecision carries allowed, gate, reason, evaluationMs, allowlistedSubagents, delegatedSubagents, and optional approvalRef/approvedBy.

AGENT_SUBAGENT_PREREQUISITE_POSTURE is contract-only and non-executable: executableDelegation 'blocked', childDefinitions 'contract-only', patternCorpusRuntime 'reference-only', concreteProviderRouting 'blocked', childCapabilityInheritance 'blocked'.
CHILD_RUN_EVENT_TYPES is the ordered list: subagent.started, subagent.progress, subagent.completed, subagent.failed.

createDelegationChildRunRecord builds a provider-neutral preflight child-run record from a governance decision, capturing parent session/turn/persona, agentName, status 'queued', and governance state.
createDelegationChildRunRecord de-duplicates requestedToolNames in the resulting capabilityPolicy.
An allowed delegation record sets capabilityPolicy.inheritParentCapabilities false, empty allowedToolNames, and deniedCapabilities ['read','write','shell','mcp','network','subagent'].
providerNeutralChildRunRecord output must not match /sdk|claude|anthropic|pi/i.
A denied governance decision yields a record with status 'denied', governance.state 'denied', inheritParentCapabilities false, and still passes validateChildRunRecord.

createAdapterObservedChildRunRecord keeps adapter-specific identifiers (adapterName, adapterSessionId, adapterTaskId, adapterToolUseId) under adapter metadata while remaining provider-neutral in the public record.
childRunRecordToEventData emits a childRunId matching /^child_/ plus agentName, status, and adapter metadata.
validateChildRunRecord flags a completed child run lacking output artifact references with issue code COMPLETED_WITHOUT_OUTPUT_ARTIFACT.

Component header for frontend/src/__tests__/lib/chirality-hooks.test.ts.
lib/harness/chirality-hooks exports createChiralityToolHooks; session-events exports replayHarnessEvents; tool-descriptor exports getHarnessToolDescriptor.
Hooks read CHIRALITY_SESSION_ROOT and CHIRALITY_INSTRUCTION_ROOT environment variables for session storage and instruction-root containment.
createChiralityToolHooks takes { sessionId, projectRoot, instructionRoot, resolveDescriptor } and returns PreToolUse and PostToolUse hook arrays.
A project-root-contained Write is allowed: PreToolUse returns continue true with hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision 'allow'.

Write PreToolUse records provenance: hookName chirality.write.pre_tool_use, decision 'approve', descriptorName 'write_file', pathMetadata with rawPath/resolvedPath and pathScope 'project-root-write', beforeState.exists, recordsDiff true.
Write PostToolUse records afterState { exists, kind 'file', byteLength, sha256 } and resultMetadata.rawOutputPersisted false under hookName chirality.write.post_tool_use.
Each Write tool invocation emits the harness event sequence hook.started, hook.completed for pre and post phases.

Write hooks block three classes: outside-project-root writes (../outside.md), writes into the instruction root, and writes through a symlink, all returning continue false, decision 'block', permissionDecision 'deny'.
Block denial messages identify the cause: 'outside the active project root', 'instruction root', and 'symbolic link' respectively.
Blocked write events carry safeMetadata.denyClass values 'path-containment', 'instruction-root', and 'symlink-write'.
Governed Bash is allowed: PreToolUse returns continue true, permissionDecision 'allow', and injects a default timeout of 120000 ms into updatedInput.
Bash PreToolUse records shellMetadata with shellPolicyVersion, effectiveTimeoutMs 120000, and timeoutSource 'defaulted'.
Large Bash output is persisted as an overflow artifact: resultMetadata budgetClass 'requires-artifact-overflow', outputPersisted true, rawOutputPersisted false.
Bash PostToolUse shellResultMetadata reports stdoutPresent, stderrPresent, byte lengths, and interrupted flag.
Overflow artifacts redact API keys: the persisted artifact omits the secret value and contains '[REDACTED_API_KEY]' (artifactMetadata.redacted true).
Bash hooks block network-capable commands (e.g. curl https://...), instruction-root reads, and symlink redirection writes, returning continue false, decision 'block'.
Blocked Bash denial messages contain 'Network-capable Bash command', 'instruction root', and 'symbolic link'.
Blocked Bash events carry safeMetadata.denyClass values 'network-command', 'instruction-root', and 'symlink-write'.

chirality-read-mcp test imports serializeDependencyRegister, DependencyRegisterRow, and read-tools exports createChiralityReadMcpServers, dependenciesReadTool, scaffoldPreviewTool, scopeScanTool, statusReadTool.
_STATUS document fixture declares Current State INITIALIZED with a History section of dated lifecycle transitions.
Status document History section lists dated state transitions: 2026-02-21 OPEN (PREPARATION) and 2026-02-22 INITIALIZED (4_DOCUMENTS).
Decomposition fixture Packages table defines PKG-05 'Filesystem Execution Model' described as 'Runtime filesystem'.
Decomposition fixture Deliverables section enumerates package deliverables.
Decomposition fixture maps deliverable DEL-05-03 'Lifecycle State Handling' (type RUNTIME) under PKG-05 Filesystem Execution Model.
makeDependencyRow fixture builds a DependencyRegisterRow with RegisterSchemaVersion v3.1, DependencyClass EXECUTION, Direction UPSTREAM, DependencyType PREREQUISITE, TargetType DELIVERABLE.
parseJsonToolResult extracts and JSON-parses the first text content item of an MCP tool result, throwing if it is not text.
Read-MCP test fixture scaffolds a project root with a PKG-05 deliverable directory containing _STATUS.md and Dependencies.csv plus a _Decomposition/decomposition.md.
statusReadTool returns parsed lifecycle status (currentState INITIALIZED) and the resolved _STATUS.md file path for a deliverable.
dependenciesReadTool returns parsed dependency register rows and warnings for a deliverable path.
status_read and dependencies_read each emit tool.started/tool.completed harness events.
status_read tool event data records source 'chirality-mcp', toolName 'status_read', adapterToolName 'mcp__chirality__status_read', and inputMetadata listing inputKeys and pathFields.

Read-MCP tool resultMetadata reports contentItemCount, contentTextByteLength, inlineByteLimit 65536, artifactByteLimit 2097152, overflowPolicy 'artifact', budgetClass 'within-inline-budget', rawOutputPersisted false.
Read-MCP harness event payloads must not leak document body content (no 'INITIALIZED' or 'DEP-05-03-001' in serialized event data).
scopeScanTool scans project scopes returning projectRoot, deliverables (id/path), and knowledgeTypes without reading document bodies.
scaffoldPreviewTool previews planned execution-root paths (executionRoot, packageCount, planned.files incl INIT.md) without creating any execution-root files on disk.
scaffoldPreviewTool rejects an executionRoot outside the active projectRoot with INVALID_REQUEST and message 'executionRoot must resolve inside projectRoot'.
A rejected scaffold_preview emits tool.started then tool.failed with failureSource 'handler' and error.errorName 'HarnessError'.
createChiralityReadMcpServers attaches the SDK 'chirality' MCP server (type 'sdk') only when at least one read MCP tool is explicitly allowlisted; returns {} for an empty allowlist.

createSdkStream wraps an array of SDKMessage events as an async generator; createQuery returns a vi.fn query producing a stream with interrupt() and close() stubs.
ClaudeAgentSdkManager constructor takes a query function and an async persona-prompt resolver; startTurn(session, message, opts) yields provider-neutral UIEvents.

startTurn calls the SDK query with prompt and options including settingSources [], tools [], allowedTools [].
A successful SDK turn appends HarnessEvent evidence in order turn.accepted, turn.started, adapter.initialized, model.delta, message.delta, model.completed, turn.completed.
Component header for frontend/src/__tests__/lib/dependencies-register-contract.test.ts.
lib/dependencies exports readDependencyRegister (register-reader), serializeDependencyRegister (register-writer), and DEPENDENCY_CORE_COLUMNS, DependencyContractError, DependencyRegisterRow (schema).

readDependencyRegister reads legacy CSV (lacking RegisterSchemaVersion), warns MISSING_SCHEMA_VERSION_COLUMN, defaults RegisterSchemaVersion to v3.1, normalizes Direction 'INBOUND' to 'UPSTREAM', and maps unknown DependencyType to 'OTHER'.
serializeDependencyRegister emits rows with canonical core header ordering equal to DEPENDENCY_CORE_COLUMNS.join(',') and sets RegisterSchemaVersion v3.1.
serializeDependencyRegister throws DependencyContractError code INVALID_CLASSIFICATION for an invalid ANCHOR classification.
serializeDependencyRegister throws INVALID_PROVENANCE for active rows missing required provenance (empty EvidenceFile/SourceRef).
serializeDependencyRegister throws INVALID_TARGET when target resolution rules fail (DELIVERABLE target without TargetDeliverableID, or DOCUMENT target with a TargetDeliverableID).
serializeDependencyRegister throws DUPLICATE_DEPENDENCY_ID when two rows share a DependencyID.
serializeDependencyRegister throws INVALID_SATISFACTION_TRANSITION when a status change violates allowed transitions versus previousRows (e.g. PENDING to SATISFIED).
serializeDependencyRegister accepts a valid satisfaction progression IN_PROGRESS to SATISFIED against previousRows.
Component header for frontend/src/__tests__/lib/engine-conformance.test.ts.
lib/harness/engine-conformance exports runEngineConformance and runEngineInterruptConformance; agent-engine-port exports AgentEnginePort and AgentEngineRunInput types.
createRunInput builds an AgentEngineRunInput { session, message, opts } with overrides for conformance fixtures.
Test fixtures sdkInit, sdkDelta, sdkSuccess, sdkFailure, sdkAssistantToolUse, sdkUserToolUseResult construct scripted SDKMessage events for engine conformance.
ScriptedEnginePort implements AgentEnginePort with subject 'stub', a scripted startTurn that yields the provided events, and a no-op interrupt.
useTempSessionRoot points CHIRALITY_SESSION_ROOT at a fresh temp directory for each conformance run.

runEngineConformance passes a Claude Agent SDK success stream against the provider-neutral engine contract: report.passed true, no issues, eventTypes session:init/chat:delta/chat:complete/session:complete/process:exit, and joined eventTypes must not match /sdk|claude|anthropic/i.

A scripted SDK tool-use turn yields conformance eventTypes session:init/chat:complete/session:complete/process:exit and replays tool lifecycle evidence tool.queued/tool.started/tool.completed with descriptorName 'read_file' and budgetClass 'within-inline-budget'.
A scripted SDK error tool result replays tool.failed with descriptorName 'search_files', failureSource 'tool_use_result', and the failure message is not leaked into event data.
A scripted provider failure is treated as terminal evidence: eventTypes session:init/process:exit with final process:exit { exitCode 1, errorType 'SDK_FAILURE', fatal true } and harness turn.failed.
An interrupted adapter turn must emit cancellation terminal evidence: final process:exit { exitCode 130, interrupted true } and harness interruption.requested/interruption.completed/turn.cancelled.
runEngineConformance flags non-public adapter event names (e.g. 'sdk:delta') with issue code UNKNOWN_UI_EVENT.
runEngineConformance flags adapters that finish without process:exit evidence with issue code MISSING_PROCESS_EXIT.
